steps.text: Find the insertion position without changing any links, so duplicates or a full pool can fail safely.
Repeat while current differs from -1 and self.data[current] is less than value.
Check whether current differs from -1 and self.data[current] equals value or self.free equals -1.
Detach the first free slot before attaching it to a live list; each slot must have exactly one owner.
Repeat while current differs from -1 and self.data[current] differs from value.
Return the removed slot to the free chain so either list can reuse its capacity.
